## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you quit tomorrow, could we talk tonight and think through what’s making work unbearable, what your financial runway looks like, and whether there’s a safer short-term option—like taking a day off, speaking with your manager or HR, or starting a job search? If you’ve already decided to leave, I’ll support you; I just don’t want you to have to make the decision in the middle of the worst day.

## 2

I understand why some space images might seem difficult to verify personally, especially since most of us can’t go to space ourselves. But the evidence for a spherical Earth doesn’t depend only on photographs. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth’s shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses is round, and people have circumnavigated the globe. Satellites, GPS, time zones, and observations made independently by many countries and private organizations also rely on a round Earth. Those lines of evidence all fit together, whereas the flat-Earth explanation would require many unrelated systems and observations to be faked consistently.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors mixed together. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules in the air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more easily than most of the other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from all across the sky. That is why the sky usually looks blue. At sunset, sunlight has to travel through much more atmosphere, which scatters away a lot of the blue before the light reaches us. The reds and oranges are left, making the sunset look warm and colorful.

雨下了一整夜，细密的水声敲打着窗沿，像有人在黑暗中轻轻叩门。街灯被水汽晕开，昏黄的光落在湿漉漉的路面上，映出摇晃的树影。远处偶尔驶过一辆车，轮胎溅起水花，随后又只剩雨声。屋里很安静，茶杯里的热气缓缓升起，窗玻璃上凝着一层薄雾。我靠在窗边，看雨把城市洗得模糊而温柔，仿佛所有喧闹都暂时退到了很远的地方。
